verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas lets users ask natural-language questions about their sales tax and get answers grounded in their own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. That is first-party natural-language interaction, but it is shown only as question-answering, not as commands that operate the product. Headless Tax's 'hand it to your agents' points to agent access, not to direct natural-language commands. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can take actions (e.g., create transactions, upload certificates, trigger filings), in-depth docs on AI Atlas scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with the reasoning shown, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates.
Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents.
